description: This file defines the MysqliManager class, a PHP class implementing MySQL database management using the mysqli extension. It provides methods for connecting, querying, disconnecting, and handling MySQL database operations, specifically tailored for SuiteCRM's database abstraction layer.

classes.name: MysqliManager
classes.description: A PHP class implementing MySQL database management using the mysqli extension, providing connection, query execution, and result handling functionalities.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query, handling both string and array inputs, with logging and error checking.

methods.name: getAffectedRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in a result set.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the database connection and frees resources.

methods.name: getFieldsArray
methods.description: Retrieves an array of field names from a result set.

methods.name: fetchRow
methods.description: Fetches a single row from the result set as an associative array.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe use in SQL queries.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the MySQL database using configuration options.

methods.name: lastDbError
methods.description: Returns the last database error message.

methods.name: getDbInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the current database connection and server.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the mysqli extension is available and not disabled.

methods.name: compareVarDefs
methods.description: Compares two field definitions, with special handling for integer length in newer MySQL versions.
